extras: Roadmap includes adding rounded corner, aspect ratio, and light/dark mode options for SVG export.
intentEvidence: In "vanilla" Obsidian, canvases can only be exported to PNG.
problem: Obsidian canvases are limited to PNG export, preventing users from obtaining scalable vector graphics.
summary: A plugin that allows users to export Obsidian canvases as clean SVG images, overcoming the limitation of default PNG export.
